issues.detail: The Greek 'τινες οι λογοι ουτοι' (what are these words) is rendered as 'nói chuyện gì' (speaking what/talking about what). The Greek refers to the content of their speech/words, whereas the Vietnamese implies the act of speaking.

The Greek 'αντιβαλλετε προς αλληλους' (you are casting against one another / arguing with each other) is omitted. The Vietnamese only mentions 'nói chuyện với nhau' (talking to each other), losing the sense of conflict or opposition.
